ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpImpersonation Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the SharpImpersonation tool. Which can be used to manipulate tokens on a Windows computers remotely (PsExec/WmiExec) or interactively

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpImpersonation\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SharpImpersonation\.exe") OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ user\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ binary\\:.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ user\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ shellcode\\:.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ technique\\:CreateProcessAsUserW.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ technique\\:ImpersonateLoggedOnuser.*"))))
